notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The refrigerator remains open while the two cabinet leaves and drawer are manipulated. The two cabinet closures occur within the short 712–728 interval, so their individual off-frame ordering is approximate.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a compact kitchen. The user opens a refrigerator, separately opens both leaves of an upper cupboard above the cooktop, opens and closes a storage drawer beside the oven, then closes the cupboard leaves and refrigerator.
